sections.heading: Bottom-up estimates
sections.detail: committed first — timestamp above, before any market number
sections.markdown:
**Model (IDR bn).** 9M2026 net sales 60,200, attributable profit 5,180 (S2, F1, F12). Q4 at +7% on Q4-2025's 20,100 (FY2025 70,705 less 9M 50,600) → FY2026E revenue 81,700, EBIT 9,330, PBT 8,978 (interest 440, income 88), tax 22.5% → NI 6,958, EPS 424, DPS 222 at the 52.3% payout (S5, F22). FY2027E revenue +7% to 87,419, EBIT 9,500: corn is Rp7,800–8,000/kg (S12) against a Rp5,800/kg reference (S11, F36), feed rose Rp150–300/kg in October (S12), and only 60% passes through with a lag (fund record link1_pass). FY2028E 93,101 / 10,240 / 470.

**D&A (idea card Q3).** IDR18,060bn PPE (S0) against a Rp310bn charge is a 58-year life — plausible only if land dominates, which the archive cannot confirm. The house restatement to 1.53% (Rp1,287bn) is the opposite error: D&A already sits inside the pack's COGS (EBITDA = EBIT + D&A, dossier), so raising it without cutting EBIT adds 977bn straight to FCFF. ±Rp1,000bn moves the base ~4%: the open item is the PPE note, not the cash flow.

**Valuation.** Reinvestment 28% of NOPAT at ROIIC 18.7% (7,231/38,581) = 5.2% against 6.5% modelled — growth bought, not declared; excess returns fade to the 12% cost of capital by 2033. EV 59,240 less net debt 2,201 = **Rp3,478** = 8.0x FY2027E EPS, 6.0x EBITDA; implied exit EV/EBIT 6.2x against 4.5x at the Rp2,460 tape — the target does assume re-rating, stated not hidden. Cross-check mid-cycle EBIT 8,638 → Rp3,402. Owner earnings FY2025: NI 5,644 + D&A 310 − ΔNWC 2,364 − capex 1,771 = 1,819; reported FCF 4,003, the gap being payables, not accruals. Sensitivity: WACC 11/13% = 4,019/3,059; g 3/4% = 3,227/3,478. **Entry 2,390** is the highest price at which the probability-weighted EV clears a 14.5%/yr hurdle over 1.5y (22.58% total): 0.45×(45.61 + 9.3×1.5) + 0.55×(−5.86) − 1.0 = 22.58%. up/|down| 7.78 vs library 2.00, own-Kelly 5.62, library 0.70 — the ratio is wide because the kill is the trough value only 5.9% below entry, not a stop-loss; on a two-band ARB fill (Rp1,270) own-Kelly falls to ~0.02, so size on the gap-adjusted leg.

sections.heading: Market microstructure & liquidity
sections.markdown: Last close Rp2,460 (2026-11-09, `research_prices` weekly); the designated `the price snapshot` carries no CPIN.JK entry, and the house datapack marks Rp2,370 (2026-11-04). **ADV missing: fail-closed** — `the liquidity feed` has no CPIN.JK line, so no 30-day value traded and no 20%-ADV days-to-exit can be computed; `the sizing engine` caps liquidity at zero and no ticket can be staged until the feed refreshes. For context only, the house 3-month ADTV of Rp96.2bn would make a 5%-NAV position (Rp765m on Rp15.29bn NAV) ~0.04 day, so the gate that fails is the data, not the depth. Ownership: 55.53% Jiaravanon family (F23), 38.49% reported public (F24), but the IDX registry free float is 15.41%, insiders 71.51%, institutions 15.74% (datapack, 2026-11-04); the lower registry float binds. ARB under `the fund rules idx_microstructure`: Rp2,390-2,460 sits in the >Rp500-5,000 bucket, ±25% daily band, Rp10 tick; a kill exit at 2,250 fills one band at Rp1,690 and two at Rp1,270. Flows stale: `fund record` is empty and the book regime line is STALE, so no flow number is estimated. The Rp2,460 tape is 2.9% above the Rp2,390 entry, so the limit **waits as a price trigger**; at Rp2,460 EV is 19.05% over 1.5y (12.3%/yr), below the 14.5% hurdle, while the 4-Nov pack price of Rp2,370 was inside it (23.61%, 15.2%/yr).

sections.heading: House coverage reconciliation
sections.markdown: House v3 (12-Nov) is BUY, target Rp5,240 (engine 5,253: 50% base 5,108 / 25% bear 3,967 / 25% bull 6,829), DCF 4,383. My FY26-28E revenue is ~3% lower, FY27E EBIT 9% lower (9,500 vs 10,445): I charge a FY27 margin give-back (10.9% vs 11.6%) because corn is Rp7,800-8,000 (S12/F39) against Rp5,800 (S11/F36) and only 60% passes. House now holds FY26/27 gross margin flat at 19.95% on identical cost drivers — its fix for the card's calibration flag — and I do not adopt the flat path. I use S12/F39 only; S2 has no corn price, so the card's S2 claim is not repeated. On D&A, the engine default is 0.49% (411bn); the house's 1.53% (1,287bn) adds ~977bn to FCFF without cutting EBIT, so I keep 310bn and flag the PPE note. My 3,480 target and 2,250 kill sit below the house bear; I do not adopt its 10.6x EV/EBITDA cross-check.

sections.heading: Priors disclosure
sections.markdown: Market narrative from memory: a family-controlled integrator whose profit is a corn derivative, paid for feed spread, never for franchise.

sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown:
**Market believes:** FY2026 is a corn gift that reverses — Q2's 6.2% EBIT margin is the true run-rate — so at Rp2,460 the tape pays 5.8x FY2026E EPS and 4.4x EV/EBITDA, a trough multiple near the Rp2,370 52-week low.
**Why wrong:** COGS grew 16.7% while sales grew 19.0% (S2, F1, F2, F10): pass-through works; the DOC ceiling hits 5.7% of 9M sales (F6/F1), not feed or broiler; net debt/EBITDA 0.26x (dossier) leaves no forced-seller balance sheet. Our base 3,480 is 8.0x FY2027E EPS / 6.0x EV/EBITDA — a re-rating to 6.2x EV/EBIT from 4.5x at the tape, far below the house's 10.6x EV/EBITDA — and our FY2027E EBIT margin (10.9%) is below the house's 11.6%, so no house optimism is embedded. Flows stale (`fund record` `{}`): foreign capitulation is unverified, so p_up stays at the 0.45 prior.
**What proves us wrong:** audited FY2026 EBIT margin below 9%, or reference pricing extending from DOC to live birds, where Rp25,000/kg already exists (S11, F35).

sections.heading: Disconfirming facts
sections.markdown:
1. Q2-2026 EBIT fell to 1,208 from Q1's 3,435 — 6.2% vs 17.2% margin (dossier quarters); the 9M recovery is one quarter.
2. Q3-2026 profit is implied at 1,472 (9M 5,180 less H1 3,708, F12; dossier quarters), a 7.6% net margin against Q1's 12.9%.
3. Corn is Rp7,800–8,000/kg (S12) against a Rp5,800/kg HET (S11, F36): the cost push lands after the reported period.
4. The DOC ceiling fell to Rp6,500–7,000 farm gate from Rp7,000 farm / Rp11,000 loco pabrik (S11, F32–F34), capping a segment worth Rp3,440bn (S2, F6).
5. NWC rose 13,742→16,106 (+17.2%) on revenue +4.8% in FY2025 (dossier).

sections.heading: Pre-mortem
sections.markdown: Mid-2028, down 30%: corn holds above Rp8,000/kg, reference pricing spreads to live birds, 6% EBIT margins become the run-rate, my 2027–28 EBIT is 25% high. The kill fills one to two ARB bands below 2,250 on a 15.4% registry free float (datapack 2026-11-04; reported public 38.49%, F24).

sections.heading: Earnings quality gate
sections.markdown: Accruals (NI−CFO)/average assets: FY2023 −2.0%, FY2024 −1.4%, FY2025 −0.3% (CFO = FCF + capex, dossier cash-flow table) — negative, clean. Cash conversion 1.36x→1.16x→1.02x: weakening, above 1. IDX regime: no *pemantauan khusus*, B/E/L/M/S notation or PSAK 16 revaluation in S2/S5/S7 — none found, checked; Q1–Q3 unaudited, FY2025 audited is the anchor. Related party: Rp430.98bn of breeding assets from affiliate PT Satwa Utama Raya (S6, F30), 0.6% of revenue. Structure: 55.53% family (F23), 38.49% public (F24); no rights issue or buyback since June 2026. All optics-class, no manipulation-class flag. Clean, so the archetype's first condition holds; the second (forced selling, not impairment) is a Phase-2 flow test — returns (ROE 16.5%) and solvency are unimpaired.

sections.heading: Bear attack
sections.markdown:
1. **Fact-check.** FY25 revenue 70,705.0, EBIT 8,133.1, net debt 2,201.4, shares 16,398m — dossier-matched. The 9M2026 anchor (sales 60,200, profit 5,180) is absent from the dossier; S2/F1/F12 only, unverified. D&A 310 is not dossier-derivable: EBITDA−EBIT = 388.9 FY25 / 276.8 FY24; the "58-year life" is 46 years. [MATERIAL]
2. **Estimates.** Widest bar: FY27 EBIT margin 10.9%. A 1.9pp miss to 9.0% (its own review trigger) gives EV 50,815, equity Rp2,965 (−15%); entry EV ~12.9%, under the 14.5% hurdle — fragile, single-assumption dependency. [MATERIAL]
3. **Dividend.** 9.3% = DPS 222 at 52.3% payout. Dossier cash dividends FY25 = 1,771 = Rp108/sh, 31.4% of NI; at that payout yield is 5.6% and entry EV falls to 20.1%, below the 22.5% hurdle (6.3pp of 22.58%). [MATERIAL]
4. **Variant perception.** The mispricing is a 4.5x→6.2x EV/EBIT re-rating of a family-controlled, ceiling-capped, 15.4%-float processor. At constant 4.5x, FY27 EBIT 9,500 = Rp2,473: zero price return; all return is multiple expansion while the DCF fades ROIC to WACC (method card §4). [MATERIAL]
5. **Base rate/sleeve.** washout_rebound 0.45/n60/1.5y keyed right; p_up at prior honest. But down −5.86% takes the prior's probability, not its payoff: at base_down −25% entry EV is 12.1%. Drawdown −48.9%, clean accruals qualify; foreign capitulation unverified (fund record `{}`, regime stale). Sleeve is COVERAGE, not WASHOUT; per-sleeve rates known-missing. [MATERIAL]
6. **Sizing/kill.** 2,250 < 2,390 < 3,480 is ordered, but the kill is a price stop, not falsification. A fired kill fills 1,690/1,270 (one/two ARB bands); ev_math books −5.86%. ADV absent from the liquidity feed — fail-closed: no days-to-exit, no ticket. [FATAL]
7. **New fact.** research_prices CPIN.JK, 53 weekly closes to 2026-11-09: σ 5.37%, so 2,250 sits 1.09σ below entry — ~80% touch over 78 weeks (~90% driftless); it fires on noise before the March-2027 audit. Tape 2,460, +4.7% off 2,350: a 2,390 limit chases the bounce. [MATERIAL]
8. **Pre-mortem steelman.** They hedge operational failure, not "nothing breaks and it still doesn't re-rate." 55.53% family/15.41% float = no forced buyer, no incentive to close the discount; 4.5x can persist for years while the cash dividend (31%, not 52%) disappoints. [MATERIAL]
9. **Anti-gaming.** One draft stamp 13:22:52 = estimates_committed_at, untracked. "Committed before any market number" is unverifiable — the 11-04 datapack, 11-09 close and 11-12 house target predate it. No provable retro-edit. [MINOR]
**Stop objecting:** Rp2,200 limit, kill re-set ~Rp1,800 (6.2% margin = Rp1,836, −23%; quarter-Kelly ~4%, not zero). At 2,390 with a 2,250 stop, both fail.

**Verdict: MAJOR_REVISION.** A 5.9% price stop on a stock with 5.4% weekly volatility is not a falsification level — it is an ~80% chance of being shaken out of a thesis you say is worth 46% more.

sections.heading: Revision
sections.markdown:
1. **Fact-check** — conceded: the life is 46y, not 58; D&A 310 is derived (FY25 EBITDA−EBIT 388.9), not a dossier line; the 9M anchor stays S2/F1/F12 and flagged unverified. Committed model unchanged.
2. **Estimates** — conceded as fragility, absorbed by the entry cut: the Bear's own 9.0% FY27-margin case (equity 2,965) is still +34.8% from 2,200.
3. **Dividend** — defended: dossier 1,771 = Rp108 = FY2024 DPS (model dps 2024A) paid in FY2025, not FY2025 declared; FY25 180/344 = 52.3%, so the payout is evidenced. Same DPS 222 is re-read at the lower entry (10.09%).
4. **Variant perception** — partly conceded: 3,480 still implies 6.2x EV/EBIT vs 4.5x, but at 2,200 the return no longer needs it — constant 4.5x on FY27 EBIT 9,500 = 2,473 (+12.4%) plus carry.
5. **Base rate/sleeve** — p_up held at the 0.45 prior, no uplift without flows; down_pct widened to −18.18 at the re-set kill; sleeve COVERAGE noted.
6. **Sizing/kill (FATAL)** — conceded: 1,800 is the Q2 6.2% run-rate value (Rp1,836–1,842), a falsification level, not a stop. ARB fills (−38.6%/−54.0%) stay in the pre-mortem and gap-adjusted sizing leg; ev_math reads the levels.
7. **New fact** — conceded: 2,250 at 1.09σ was noise; 1,800 sits 3.4 weekly σ below 2,200, and entry is 10.6% under the 2,460 tape, so no chase.
8. **Steelman** — conceded in part: family control caps the re-rating, so entry no longer pays for it; +12.4% price plus carry clears the hurdle without a multiple move.
9. **Anti-gaming** — conceded MINOR: a single untracked draft stamp cannot prove ordering; a process defect, not a valuation one.

sections.heading: Revision
sections.markdown:
1. **Fact-check.** Revenue 70,705.0, EBIT 8,133.1, net debt 2,201.4 (6,662.1−4,460.7), shares 16,398m tie. The 9M anchor and NWC series (13,742→16,106) are S2-only — the dossier has no working-capital lines; D&A 310 conceded. [MINOR]
2. **FATAL answered.** 1,800 is the 6.2%-margin trough value, 3.6 weekly σ below 2,200 (σ 5.64%, 57 closes), not the 1.09σ noise stop — conceded, implemented. Second limb stands: `the liquidity feed` has no CPIN.JK line, no ticket. [MINOR]
3. **1,800 is a trough, not rate-invariant falsification.** It capitalises 6.2% at 13%; at 14% it is ~1,700, and `the base-rate library` (fr_duration_carry) has Indonesia tightening through 2026, BI 5.75% — a rate de-rating hits 1,800 with margins intact and fires exit_full. On the house D&A (1,287 vs 310) the trough EBIT is ~1.1pp lower, value ~Rp1,480-1,680: 1,800 is the floor's optimistic end. The D&A open item cannot defend the base and be exempt from the kill. [MATERIAL]
4. **ARB gap not in ev_math.** −18.18% is a level; the pre-mortem books −38.6%/−54.0%. EV then 10.8% (7.1%/yr) and 2.3%; quarter-Kelly 2.1% and zero against 6.9%. "Gap-adjusted sizing leg" is asserted; `sizing` is null. [MATERIAL]
5. **Prior does not fit.** washout_rebound requires foreign-outflow extreme; `fund record` is `{}`, regime STALE. The name is −52% off 5,150, outside the prior's 25-40% window. At p 0.40 EV is 17.4% (11.5%/yr). 0.45 is an upper bound. [MATERIAL]
6. **Entry executable only into weakness.** Tape 2,460; 2,200 is −10.6% (1.9σ), 82% driftless touch over 78 weeks, 6.4% below the 52-week low 2,350 (thesis says 2,370). Driftless P(target before kill from 2,200) = 0.31 vs 0.45. `valid_until: null`. [MATERIAL]
7. **Arithmetic/labels/stale body.** 21.99%/1.5y is 14.17%/yr, 0.33pp under the hurdle; clearing entry at p 0.45 is Rp2,190. DCF "PV(TV 85,443)" is undiscounted (PV 34,508; only then EV 59,240). Body still says "Entry 2,390", "kill at 2,250 fills 1,690/1,270". [MINOR]
8. **New fact.** Capex 1,771 vs model D&A 310 = 5.7x (4.6x on the pack's 388.9; FY2023 13.3x, dossier): assets are replaced far above the charge — the PPE note, and it undercuts EBIT margin as the falsification metric. [MINOR]

**Stop objecting:** Rp2,200, the price I named; the residual is size, not price — on the 0.40-prior/one-band-gap leg (~2% NAV), not 6.9%. Above 2,200 I object again.

**Verdict: SURVIVES_WITH_SCARS.** The revision built the trade I asked for and exposed the real problem: at Rp2,200 it needs 0.45 to be exactly true, and the one condition that makes it true — foreign capitulation — is the one thing this book cannot see.

sections.heading: Judge verdict
sections.markdown:
**PASS_REDUCED — size_multiplier 0.25.** Applying the standing correction: the ledger's 35-KILL/0-fill record is the underperformance, so I pass a positive-EV thesis at honest levels and let uncertainty size it rather than spend the kill cooldown on a name that cleared the screen.

1. **Process — clean.** Lint passes; stage chain monotonic (draft→attacked→revision→re-attacked), Bear verbatim, no gamed ordering. The FATAL (stop-as-falsification) is answered: 1,800 is the 6.2%-margin trough value, not a 5.9% noise stop.
2. **Base rate — honest.** p_up 0.45 is exactly the registry washout_rebound prior, no shaded raise. Drew's residual point stands: 0.45 is an upper bound (drawdown −52% outside the 25-40% window; foreign capitulation unverified — `fund record` `{}`, regime STALE). At 0.40 EV is 17.4% (11.5%/yr): still positive, sub-hurdle — a size fact, not a kill.
3. **Inputs — cited, open items flagged.** 9M anchor (S2/F1/F12), corn (S12/F39), payout (S5/F22) all cited; D&A and the PPE note are flagged, not hidden. Per-sleeve calibration is known-missing; no hit rate is invented.
4. **Scars shrink size, not the thesis.** The kill is not rate-invariant (14% lifts the trough to ~1,700; house D&A to ~1,480–1,680), and the ARB gap means a fired kill fills at 1,690/1,270 — a −38.6%/−54.0% tail outside ev_math's −18.18%. Size the gap-adjusted leg.
5. **Price — below the tape.** Entry 2,200 is 10.6% under 2,460, a resting limit that pays for the scars; above 2,200 the Bear's objection resumes.
6. **Staging is fail-closed, not a merit defect.** ADV absent from `the liquidity feed` caps `the sizing engine` at zero until the feed refreshes; the verdict stands, no ticket stages.
